title: Front matter of a principle
description: The YAML front matter of a principle (principles/P<number>.md). The identifier is the file name. A principle has no scope fields.

name.description: A speaking name: lowercase words joined by hyphens. It may change; only the identifier counts.

status.description: planned: published and citable, not yet in use. active: in use. retired: the file stays.

replaced-by.description: The principle that took the place of a retired principle.
